gloss: various kinds; all sorts; each type

definitions.gloss: various kinds, all sorts, each type
definitions.explanation: Refers to a variety of different kinds or types. Used as a modifier before nouns to mean 'various' or 'of all kinds.'

examples.japanese: {各種|かくしゅ}{手続|てつづ}き。
{各種|かくしゅ}サービスを{提供|ていきょう}しています。
examples.english: We offer various types of services.

examples.japanese: {各種|かくしゅ}{保険|ほけん}の{比較|ひかく}サイトで{自分|じぶん}に{合|あ}ったプランを{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I looked for a plan that suited me on a comparison site for various types of insurance.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{各種|かくしゅ}{手続|てつづ}き (various procedures)
・{各種|かくしゅ}サービス (various services)
・{各種|かくしゅ}{保険|ほけん} (various types of insurance)
・{各種|かくしゅ}{団体|だんたい} (various organizations)
・{各種|かくしゅ}{資格|しかく} (various qualifications)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{各種|かくしゅ} is more formal than {色々|いろいろ}な (various) and emphasizes that each separate type is included. It appears frequently in business, administrative, and official contexts. {様々|さまざま}な is another synonym but is more general and literary. {各種|かくしゅ} directly modifies nouns without の or な.
